messages:
Maria G: Heads-up: LangChain + Gateway + Orchestrator pilot planning thread. Objective: sandbox integration, marketplace listing, and joint announcement with partners (LangChain + SigmaCompute). Who can own what?
Aj Patel: I can own the SDK + sample repo. timeline?
Kevin L: Infra needs a clear perf/compat checklist: routing policies, quantized model loads on Dedicated, LlamaIndex memory/backends, and failover behavior. Please add sequence length & batch size columns.
Raj (partner-eng): LangChain PM asked for 7 days of private validation before any public mention. They also want an example LangChain chain that uses our orchestrator as an endpoint + a short SDK snippet.
Sophie R: Marketing: we'll need co-branded assets (SVG logos, short bios), an embargo window, hero screenshot for marketplace, and a customer-facing one-liner. Prefer 10 business days but can compress to 2 weeks with partner signoff.
Maria G: Proposal: Week A internal smoke tests + LangChain validation. Week B marketplace entry + press/blog + coordinated demo. Keep a 24h fallback for staggered release if needed.
Kevin L: I'll author the test matrix. Initial defaults: sequence_length=2048, batch_size=8. Smoke tests: 1) orchestration end-to-end with gateway routing policies, 2) quantized model load & inference on Dedicated, 3) KV cache correctness in LlamaIndex pipeline, 4) fallback variant failover correctness, 5) smoke endpoint returns gpu util and model hash.
Aj Patel: Draft SDK snippet (will be idiomatic):
```
# python pseudo snippet
from redwood import Orchestrator
orch = Orchestrator(api_key="<REDACTED>")
# route through gateway to LangChain-compatible handler
resp = orch.run(model="llama-quantized", policy={"route":"langchain-gateway"}, input_text="Summarize the doc")
print(resp.text)
```
Aj Patel: I'll also add a tiny LangChain chain example that calls orch.run as an LLM wrapper.
Raj (partner-eng): LangChain shared validation checklist: test memory backends, ensure save/load semantics in LlamaIndex, verify streaming + function-calls work through gateway. I put their docs in the shared drive.
Sophie R: I'll assemble marketplace copy: short description, recommended hardware (SigmaCompute), quickstart bullets, and link to sample repo. Need partner quote from LangChain — @Raj can you secure?
Raj (partner-eng): Got the quote in draft. LangChain legal wants a quick review before we publish. Also SigmaCompute provided perf numbers and asked we mention them as "recommended for high-throughput configs".
Maria G: Legal will send an attribution template. We'll tag SigmaCompute in the marketplace entry under "recommended hardware" rather than a formal partner block.
Kevin L: Operational ask: add a /_redwood/smoke endpoint on the gateway that returns a small JSON with model version, gpu_util, and config hash. I'll open a PR. deploy-bot, can you schedule a staging canary?
deploy-bot: Deploy requested by Kevin L: staging canary at 19:00 UTC. Status: scheduled. :robot_face:
Sophie R: Announcement cadence: prefer same-day simultaneous blog + partner post + marketplace. LangChain prefers coordinated release; they can accept a 24h stagger if we need more QA. SigmaCompute prefers same-day.
Maria G: Actions/owners: Aj - SDK snippet + sample repo by EOD Fri; Kevin - smoke endpoint + perf test matrix by Thu; Raj - secure LangChain quote + legal approvals by Wed; Sophie - draft marketplace and comms by Thu. I'll drive the announcement timeline and embargo.
Aj Patel: Will drop the repo link and a minimal README with LangChain chain example when ready.
Kevin L: I'll include perf numbers for Dedicated and a short tuning runbook (batching, KV cache warmup).
Raj (partner-eng): Uploaded LangChain logos and draft quote into shared folder. Also updated validation notes: https://internal/notes/langchain-validation
Sophie R: I'll prepare the press list and partner cross-post copy. We should plan an internal demo 4 hours before go-live.
Maria G: Good call. Reconvene Thu 09:00 UTC for pre-canary run. Ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:
